variants.name: 100 g
variants.about_this_item: Beaphar Malt Paste is a special snack to give as a daily treat. Malt Paste eases the passage of hairballs through the digestive tract. Valuable oils and fats are important for the energy supply of your cat. MOS (Mannan Oligo-saccharide) supports healthy intestinal bacteria and the calcium is of importance for a good development of teeth and bones.
variants.ingredient_information: Composition: Oils and fats, milk and milk derivatives, derivatives of vegetable origin, yeast, minerals.
variants.feeding_instructions: Feeding advice: Long haired cats: give 6 cm paste daily, either over the food or directly from the tube. Short haired cats: give 4 cm paste daily, either over the food or directly from the tube. If necessary, the amount can be doubled. Store in a cool place. Always keep fresh drinking water available.
